concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-orchestration-ebanx]] - 2026-09-16 Braintree-hosted EBANX orchestration guide for Braintree SDK/GraphQL transaction operations, dual-side account and environment-key setup, mandatory customer data, and reconciliation-aware fulfillment; distinct from Forward API and not independent EBANX authority, settlement proof or funding proof
warnings: Keep Payment Orchestration distinct from Forward API request construction and do not transfer forwarding-only constraints into this documented operation.
This Braintree-hosted guide is not independent EBANX authority and its lifecycle examples do not prove settlement or funding for an individual transaction.
